era: PS2 / PSP / PS3 / PS4 / PS5 / PC
summary: Insomniac's sci-fi action-platformer series, spanning the PS2 trilogy, Future saga, PSP/mobile side games, PS3 co-op/tower-defense experiments, the 2016 reimagining, and Rift Apart.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank

emulation.notes: Prefer PS3 collection; use PCSX2 for original PS2 comparison.

primary.why: The PS3 collection remasters the first three PS2 games with HD presentation, trophies, and 60 fps normal mode, making it the best official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Ratchet & Clank Collection on PS3/RPCS3; use PS2 via PCSX2 only for original-hardware comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2016 game is a reimagining, not a replacement for this original.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando

primary.why: The PS3 collection includes Going Commando in HD with trophy support and normal 60 fps play.
primary.how_to_play: Play Ratchet & Clank Collection on PS3/RPCS3.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original PS2 remains a preservation reference.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal

primary.why: The PS3 collection includes Up Your Arsenal in HD and preserves its multiplayer component in collection form, although PSN multiplayer servers are no longer live.
primary.how_to_play: Play Ratchet & Clank Collection on PS3/RPCS3 for the single-player campaign.

entries.remaster_caveats: Multiplayer server shutdown affects current completeness.

entries.title: Ratchet: Deadlocked

primary.why: Deadlocked shipped on PS2 and later received a PS3 release, making the PS3 route the highest-fidelity official version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 release through RPCS3 or PS3 hardware; use PS2 via PCSX2 as fallback.

entries.remaster_caveats: Online/multiplayer availability can differ from the original live era.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank Future: Tools of Destruction

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Tools of Destruction is a PS3-only Future saga entry with no PC/remaster route documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or through RPCS3 if compatibility is acceptable.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank Future: Quest for Booty

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Quest for Booty is a PS3-only downloadable/retail Future saga episode with no later remaster documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or through RPCS3 if compatible.

entries.remaster_caveats: Short downloadable episode; no PC/PS4/PS5 remaster documented.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank Future: A Crack in Time

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: A Crack in Time is a PS3-only Future saga entry with no later remaster documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or through RPCS3 if compatibility is acceptable.

primary.why: Into the Nexus is a PS3-only epilogue to the Future saga with no later PC/remaster route documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or through RPCS3 if compatible.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart

primary.why: Rift Apart launched on PS5 and later came to PC, making PC the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version with current patches and SSD/storage settings appropriate for the port.

entries.remaster_caveats: Storage and shader/driver behavior matter more on PC than PS5.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: Size Matters

primary.why: Size Matters was built for PSP and later ported to PS2; the PSP original is the cleanest intended route, with PPSSPP providing the fidelity ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP version through PPSSPP at high internal resolution; use PS2 only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: PS2 port exists but is not a modern remaster.

entries.title: Secret Agent Clank

primary.why: Secret Agent Clank was developed as a PSP title and later ported to PS2; PSP original is the intended route and upscales well in PPSSPP.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP version through PPSSPP at high internal resolution.

entries.remaster_caveats: PS2 port exists but is not a modern remaster.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: All 4 One

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if online/local setup is easier.

primary.why: All 4 One is a PS3-only cooperative spin-off with no later remaster documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or through RPCS3 if compatibility is acceptable; local/online co-op availability may matter.

entries.remaster_caveats: Co-op/server conditions can affect current completeness.

primary.why: Full Frontal Assault/QForce shipped on PS3 and Vita; PS3 is the higher-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 version through RPCS3 or PS3 hardware; use Vita only for portable comparison.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank

primary.why: The 2016 Ratchet & Clank is a PS4 reimagining tied to the film, not a port of the 2002 original; PS5 compatibility is the best current console route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 release on PS5 compatibility or PS4 hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate with the 2002 original; this is a reimagining.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: Going Mobile

emulation.emulator: Java ME/mobile preservation tools if compatible
emulation.notes: Use preserved mobile build if available.

primary.why: Going Mobile is a J2ME mobile title, released on mobile.
primary.how_to_play: Archive-only unless a compatible handset or Java ME preservation route is available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legacy mobile availability is the main blocker.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: Clone Home

emulation.emulator: Java ME/mobile preservation tools if compatible

primary.why: Clone Home was originally cancelled but was recovered and made available in October 2025.
primary.how_to_play: Use the recovered build through a compatible Java ME preservation route; archive the provenance alongside the game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Archive/recovered status means provenance matters more than normal storefront availability.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank: Before the Nexus

primary.why: Before the Nexus is an iOS/Android mobile tie-in for Into the Nexus.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned compatible mobile route if still available in the user's region/account.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile store availability can change over time.

entries.title: Ratchet & Clank Collection

primary.why: The collection remasters the first three PS2 games for PS3 and includes Up Your Arsenal multiplayer support in collection form.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 version through RPCS3 or PS3 hardware; avoid Vita if fidelity is the priority.

entries.remaster_caveats: Collection covers only the first three games; Deadlocked is separate.
